title: Computer Science I
requiresNote: Any 100-level COMP course, or equivalent programming experience. If you haven't taken one at Wesleyan, talk to the instructor first.
summary: The first half of the gateway sequence you need to declare the major: programming in imperative and functional languages, correctness and cost, and proofs about programs.
take: Maybe you've seen code before, but you don't really know what its doing. Get ready to figure it out.
